problem: Conductor creates draft PRs and posts Codex requests, but after Codex finishes the PR stays in draft. Linear issues remain in implementation status until manually updated.
solution: Add default-branch-only readiness gate that requires bot-authored draft, exact SHA clean Codex status and final receipt, and passing push plus pull-request CI before marking Ready for review. Add separate GitHub-event lifecycle sync for bot PR creation and owner merge, using a dedicated optional Linear write token. No automated approval or merging.
tests: Node unit tests for Codex receipt, stale SHA, failure paths, CI prerequisites and PR identity
Node unit tests for authenticated Linear issue/PR matching, no accidental Done on closed unmerged PR, and state transitions
Run repository CI: lint, formatting, TypeScript, tests, package checks and Storybook
risks: Linear lifecycle transitions require a separately provisioned LINEAR_LIFECYCLE_API_KEY secret; absent key safely skips. Codex readiness gate uses a restricted GitHub App token and main-branch script. GitHub readyForReview mutation cannot atomically specify an expected SHA, so branch protection and live recheck remain mandatory. No merges occur.
review: Review all token scopes, exact reviewed SHA and CI success checks, Codex latest summary and receipt, no unreviewed PR execution, correct Linear team/issue linkage, and no merge permissions. Verify that ready and Done never occur on failed checks or unmerged PRs.
